reanimateEachChosenTapped returns the chosen cards that are still legal targets together, tapped, under the caster (CR 608.2b, 603.6a)

clauses.oracleText: When this creature enters, bolster 2.

the creature is a choice made on resolution, not a target: a unique least-toughness creature is picked without a prompt, a tie lets the controller choose, and Elite Scaleguard itself is a candidate (it bolsters itself when alone or least tough)

clauses.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, tap target creature defending player controls.

the tap target is a creature controlled by the player the attacker is attacking (defendingPlayerIsEventPlayer, target controller eventPlayer), and each such attacker triggers once

clauses.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

the trigger is optional: its controller is asked whether to use the ability and the counter is put on Forgotten Ancient only on yes

clauses.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures.
implementation: interpreted upkeep trigger for its controller only whose distributeCountersFromSource effect has the controller assign +1/+1 counters one at a time to other creatures (any controller, never itself or a noncreature) or stop with Move no more counters, so any number from none to all may move
the assigned counters then move together, one placement per recipient (CR 122.5), so a counter-doubling replacement such as Hardened Scales applies once to each creature rather than once per counter

clauses.oracleText: Whenever you put a counter on a creature you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
implementation: interpreted countersPut trigger whose byYou filter matches only counters its controller puts, on a creature that controller controls (an effect of theirs, or a creature of theirs entering with counters, CR 122.6a), of any counter kind
the trigger's oncePerTurn limit lets it trigger a single time each turn; a counter an opponent puts on your creature, or that you put on theirs, neither triggers it nor uses up the limit

clauses.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with base power and toughness 1/1 enter, put a +1/+1 counter on Bess.

the creature filter matches on printed (base) power and toughness 1/1, not current, so a base-1/1 that enters with a counter counts and a printed 2/2 or an opponent's 1/1 does not; Bess is a 1/1 but is not an other creature, so her own entry does not count

clauses.oracleText: Whenever Bess attacks, each other creature you control with base power and toughness 1/1 gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Bess.

X is fixed as the trigger resolves, so Bess later losing counters does not change the pump; the base filter ignores counters and other modifications, so a base-1/1 carrying counters is pumped too
